[ -vserver <vserver name> ]        Vserver Name (default:
                                     gcnv-svm-01)
   { [-path] <path>                  LUN Path
   |  -volume <volume name>          Volume Name
    [ -qtree <qtree name> ]          Qtree Name (default: "")
     [-lun] <text> }                 LUN Name
   [-igroup|-g] <text (size 1..96)>  Igroup Name
  [[-lun-id] {0..4095}]              LUN ID
